name: leave-the-light-on
description: LEAVE THE LIGHT ON - a first-person psychological horror game about grief (Three.js / WebGL2)

scripts.desktop: npm run build && cd desktop && npm i --no-save @electron/packager && node -e "require('fs').cpSync('../dist','game',{recursive:true})" && npx @electron/packager . LeaveTheLightOn --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --electron-version=33.2.0 --out=out --overwrite --no-prune --ignore='^/node_modules|^/out|^/launchers|^/README.txt' && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of fs.readdirSync('launchers'))fs.copyFileSync('launchers/'+f,'out/LeaveTheLightOn-win32-x64/'+f);fs.copyFileSync('README.txt','out/LeaveTheLightOn-win32-x64/README.txt')"
